name: ui-ux-studio
description: UI/UX design studio: a director skill that orchestrates real-world-inspired UI work — it decides when to design from rules alone, when to pull concrete references, and when the reference library is too thin and must be grown by discovering + extracting new sites. Bundles the ui-ux-references example library, a ui-ux-gallery skill to browse it, and composes with the external ui-ux-pro-max rules skill.
